'''Yamato Okunitama Shrine''' (やまとおおくにたまじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in [[Mima City]], [[Tokushima Prefecture]]. It is one of the proposed locations of the ancient shrines "Ichisha Shikinaisha Awa Kuni Mima District Yamato Okunitama God Okuni Shikinaisha Niza". This identification is based on the "Awa-shi" (records of Awa Province), which suggests the shrine could be "Ike Shrine" and adds that there may be doubt about distinguishing them as separate entities.

== Overview ==
The exact date of establishment is unknown.
